title: Programming N-linked glycan composition through de novo protein design
authors: Margaret C Lunn-Halbert; Joel D Allen; Rohith Krishna; Anna Manchenko; Xinting Li; Edward D Lopatto; Jerome Pinkner; Carolina Moller; Woody Ahern; Johnny Mendoza; Alex Kang; Hannah Nguyen; Emily Joyce; Asim Bera; Scott J Hultgren; Evgeni Sokurenko; Max Crispin; David Baker; Neil P King
one_liner_zh: 该文通过从头蛋白设计编程N-连接糖基化组成，利用三维结构调控糖基加工，虽以糖蛋白为对象，但其全原子计算设计流程和结构-序列编码方法对蛋白质结构计算设计具有直接借鉴意义。
abstract: N-linked glycans are ubiquitous post-translational modifications that mediate diverse biological processes, including cell signaling and adhesion, molecular recognition, and host-pathogen interactions. Despite their importance, N-linked glycans have largely remained beyond the reach of biomolecular design due to a lack of methods capable of jointly modeling glycans and protein structure. Here, we develop a general all-atom computational pipeline for creating de novo glycoproteins in which the amino acid sequence encodes both the location and composition of N-linked glycans. The method uses three-dimensional protein structure to tune glycan accessibility to processing enzymes in the eukaryotic secretory pathway. Systematic increases in steric restriction progressively reduced processing, shifting glycans from heterogeneous complex-type structures toward increasingly underprocessed oligomannose-type species resembling those found on many viral glycoproteins. Despite this programmed restriction, the resulting oligomannose glycans remained accessible for biological recognition, inhibiting uropathogenic Escherichia coli adhesion to human bladder cells and binding mannose-binding lectin. These results establish steric control of N-glycan processing as a genetically encodable design principle and extend computational protein design to functional glycoproteins with programmed composition.
abstract_zh: N-连接聚糖是普遍存在的翻译后修饰，介导多种生物过程，包括细胞信号传导与黏附、分子识别以及宿主-病原体相互作用。尽管其重要性，N-连接聚糖在很大程度上仍超出生物分子设计的范畴，原因是缺乏能够联合建模聚糖和蛋白质结构的方法。在此，我们开发了一种通用的全原子计算流程，用于创建从头设计的糖蛋白，其中氨基酸序列同时编码N-连接聚糖的位置和组成。该方法利用三维蛋白质结构来调节聚糖在真核分泌途径中对加工酶的可及性。空间限制的系统性增加逐步减少了加工过程，使聚糖从异质性复合型结构转向日益未加工的寡甘露糖型种类，类似于许多病毒糖蛋白上发现的类型。尽管存在这种程序化限制，所得寡甘露糖聚糖仍保持生物识别可及性，抑制了尿路致病性大肠杆菌对人类膀胱细胞的黏附，并能够结合甘露糖结合凝集素。这些结果确立了N-聚糖加工的立体控制作为一种基因可编码的设计原则，并将计算蛋白质设计扩展到具有程序化组成的功能性糖蛋白。
